{'text': '並非所有人都知道呢件事（我都唔會假裝自己一早知道），但 Apple 確實會為幾十款旗下裝置發布極為詳細嘅尺寸圖，協助配件生產商設計配合嘅產品。以下係相關詳情。', 'translation': 'Not everyone knows this (and I won’t pretend I did), but Apple actually publishes extremely detailed dimensional drawings for dozens of its devices to help accessory manufacturers design compatible products. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'Apple 硬件，一覽無遺', 'translation': 'Apple hardware, laid bare'}

{'text': '將近三十年嚟，Jason Kottke 一直係我喺互聯網（以至其他領域）獲取有趣內容嘅主要來源之一，好多嘢如果唔係靠佢，我肯定永遠都唔會發現。', 'translation': 'For nearly three decades, Jason Kottke has been one of my primary sources of interesting things on the internet (and beyond), and I’m sure there’s a great deal I would never have discovered without him.'}

{'text': '幾日前，佢發咗一篇 post，連結去 Apple 開發者網站配件區入面嘅「Dimensional Drawings」（尺寸圖）專頁。', 'translation': 'A few days ago, he posted a link to the “Dimensional Drawings” section of the accessories area on Apple’s developer site.'}

{'text': '簡單講，呢度係一個收錄極為詳細技術圖嘅資料庫，現時涵蓋 96 款裝置，當中包括全新 iPhone 18 Pro、Apple Watch Ultra 4 同 Series 12，以及 AirPods 5。', 'translation': 'In short, it’s a repository of highly detailed technical drawings, currently covering 96 devices, including the new iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12, and AirPods 5.'}

{'text': '清單仲包括 MacBook Neo 同 Siri Remote 等產品，仲有 AirTag、AirPods 充電盒，以至 Apple Vision Pro 嘅 ZEISS Optical Inserts 等配件。', 'translation': 'The list also includes products like MacBook Neo and the Siri Remote, as well as accessories such as AirTag, AirPods charging cases, and ZEISS Optical Inserts for Apple Vision Pro.'}

{'text': '每份文件都載有由裝置整體尺寸、曲面，以至按鍵、鏡頭、感應器、喇叭同連接埠嘅精確量度資料，仲有詳盡嘅「keepout zone」（淨空區域）標示，清楚指示邊啲位置唔可以放置特定物料。', 'translation': 'Each document contains precise measurements of everything from overall device dimensions and curves to buttons, cameras, sensors, speakers and ports, along with detailed “keepout zone” markings showing where specific materials must not be placed.'}

{'text': '雖然呢啲文件主要係為配件生產商而設，但對任何對硬件、工業設計有少許興趣嘅人，甚至純粹鍾意 Apple 產品嗰種一絲不苟精神嘅人，都應該會覺得值得一看。', 'translation': 'Although these documents are primarily intended for accessory manufacturers, anyone with even a passing interest in hardware, industrial design, or simply the meticulous nature of Apple’s products should find them worth a look.'}

{'text': '想睇 Apple 嘅尺寸圖，請撳呢個連結。如果你未開始追蹤 kottke.org，記得即刻 follow。', 'translation': 'To view Apple’s dimensional drawings, follow this link. And if you’re not already following kottke.org, you should start now.'}
